reviews.title: A good Motherboard, but not ideal for overclocking.
reviews.comment: A very good motherboard for the price. A good fit for someone that wants a premium product that he/she can install on a PC and power it on. I tried to do some tweaking on the RAM but the system was not stable, and I cannot say that the problem was the motherboard because the RAM was not listed on the MSI website at the time that i purchased the MSI MAG X870E + Ryzen 9 9950x combo. I has to update the bios in order for the motherboard to recognize the RAM. So, if you are an advanced user that want to overclock the RAM and CPU, you probably need to do a more through research and select a RAM module that is in the list of the supported RAM on the MSI website. I could turn into an overclocking freak and try a bunch of settings but at the moment I'm using the PC for my school and I cannot afford to sit with an unstable PC, so I'm avoiding any overclocking adventures.
